blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While public trust in President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has slightly increased in September, Vice President Sara Duterte continued to post a higher trust rating despite her ongoing impeachment trial, according to a Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey. The latest SWS survey, released on Tuesday and was commissioned by local think-tank Stratbase Group, showed that 36 percent of Filipinos said they had “much trust” in Marcos – 2 percentage points higher than his 34 percent trust rating in June 2026. The increase in Marcos’ trust ratings can partly be attributed to an 18-percentage-point bump in Mindanao, the Dutertes’ bailiwick. The survey […]...
